method.durations: Exclude starts above source; separate pending origins, true no-lineage, errors, and right censoring including source not reached. No-lineage is also unobserved advancement, never an observed duration.
method.latePostExit: Accepted P events dated in last half of configured horizon whose owning arc pre-state has perils=exited; exact event-tick inspection, including reentry. D events excluded because D has no perils state.
method.multiBody: At least two bodies ever inhabited by one lineage, not necessarily simultaneous. Outcome class counts are per seed; lineage counts separate.
method.failures: Repeat launch counts use actual earlier failures (omniscient measurement only), not the causal knowledge available to targeting.
